decisions.reason: The cobot loading system automates the firm's own CNC machines and draws directly on its existing machine-tool and automation knowledge, so management can read early customer feedback and refine the product rather than abandon it after one year.

The dual-table loading system is a close extension of the firm's milling-machine workpiece handling, so it fits existing competencies, needs little new knowledge to improve, and supports sales of its core machines.

The dispensing machine builds on the firm's established dispensing and motion-control expertise, has a page of its own and won a Red Dot design award, which signals strong commitment and good prospects for further development.
